scope: Public GitHub default-tree Markdown only; not an institutional or scientific audit.

method.active_selection: Exclude paths containing /old/, /history/, /historical/, /previous-work/, /archived/ or preserved-public-snapshots. This is a path-based working subset, not an authoritative document-role classification.
method.links: Rendered inline Markdown [label](destination) links, excluding fenced code and simple inline code spans; destination containing case-insensitive VNext/VNEXT. HTML, reference-style Markdown, plain-text references and external-repository crawling are outside this count.
method.links_accuracy: Automated preliminary inventory; use source classification and review before inferring link-rule violations.
